messages.subject: Bangchak | Energy security, green growth and strategic stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Kovavisarach and Bangchak Leadership Team,

Bangchak's current focus on energy security, biofuels, green growth and resilient energy systems resonates strongly with my work at the intersection of resource operations, energy transition and government engagement.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and senior stakeholder strategy.

I bring practical transition experience from a remote industrial operation where I have supported governance and external engagement around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage. I have also coordinated carbon-data readiness using physical operating records and managed complex regulatory, community and executive interfaces. This gives me a grounded perspective on energy resilience and low-carbon growth.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional leadership roles across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or Country Strategy. I have attached a Bangchak-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
